instruction: For this task, start with `/home/user/Desktop/derating_base.yaml` and `/home/user/Desktop/derating_base.py` for three in-line `nrel_5MW` turbines at `x=[0,630,1260] m`. Work from the command line. Write `/home/user/Desktop/derating.py`: load the YAML; set wind direction `270 deg`, wind speed `8 m/s`, and turbulence intensity `0.06`; run a baseline with all turbines unconstrained and compute `P_base`; record turbine 0's baseline available power; call `set_operation_model("simple-derating")`; set turbine 0's power setpoint to exactly 80% of that baseline available power while leaving turbines 1 and 2 unconstrained; rerun and compute `P_derated`; and compute `net_change_kw=P_derated_kw-P_base_kw`. Execute the script and write `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as `P_base_kw, P_derated_kw, net_change_kw`. Do not use yaw control as a substitute for derating. Do not use a GUI. [Software] Use Python with `floris==4.6.4`. For this task, FLORIS is provided as the Python `floris` package at `/home/user/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/floris`; run the workflow from Python rather than looking for a separate desktop program.
